node.statement: Let R=L_U^{-1}(J). Then U bold-dot R=J and ||R||<=3. Since U^dagger=U^dagger bold-dot(U bold-dot R), R=(U^dagger bold-dot U) bold-dot R, the associator axiom gives ||U^dagger-R||<=epsilon_r||U||^2||R||<=12*epsilon_r. Therefore ||U bold-dot U^dagger-J||=||U bold-dot(U^dagger-R)||<=(1+epsilon_r)||U||*12*epsilon_r<25*epsilon_r.
